candidates.spoken: That quietly doubled the load on one set of nuts.
The Hyatt Regency walkways collapsed onto a crowded hotel lobby.
In seconds, one hundred fourteen people were dead.
So how does a walkway just drop?
LOAD ON UPPER BOX BEAM DOUBLES.
Now every connection change needs the engineer's approval.
box-beam connection pull-through from a doubled hanger-rod load.
During construction, it was swapped for two shorter rods.
The design used one long rod through both walkways.
a rod change that doubled the load on one connection.
Under the crowd, the nuts pulled straight through the beam.
The original design was already weak.
It started with one rod becomes two. It ended with both hit the crowded lobby.
Jul 17, 1981: Tea dance in the atrium; walkways crowded.
